text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (June 11, 2024) for 510 Dawes Road

The Property Standards Committee - Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (June 11, 2024) for 510 Dawes Road, Folder Number 24 162214 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to October 21, 2024 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
